messages.author: 16524dc094cde87d
messages.subject: error/warning while fitting a SEM
parts:
Hi All,

   This is the Mplus code (which runs perfectly in Mplus) I am trying to run using lavaan but I run into an error.
    wll1@1;
    wll1 by vmtr1 @ 1.205;
    wll1 by vmtr2 @ 1.772;
    wll1 by vmtr3 @ 2.267;
    wll1 by vmtr4 @ 2.448;
    wll1 by vmtr5 @ 2.445;
    wll1 by vmdrc*;
    [ vmtr2@  6.294];
    [ vmtr3@  7.464]; 
    [ vmtr4@  8.260]; 
    [ vmtr5@  8.918]; 
    vmtr1 with vmtr2; vmdrc with vmtr5; vmtr2 with vmtr3; 
    vmtr1 on agecen*; wll1 on agecen* ; wll1 on edcen* ;

##################

 And this is R code:

model <- '
   # latent variables
     wll1 =~ 1.205*vmtr1 + 1.772*vmtr2 + 2.267*vmtr3 + 2.448*vmtr4 + 2.445*vmtr5 + vmdrc
   # intercepts

     vmtr2 ~ 6.294*1
     vmtr3 ~ 7.464*1
     vmtr4 ~ 8.260*1
     vmtr5 ~ 8.918*1
   # regressions
     wll1 ~ agecen
     wll1 ~ edcen
     vmtr1 ~ agecen
   # residual covariances
     vmtr1 ~~ vmtr2
     vmdrc ~~ vmtr5
     vmtr2 ~~ vmtr3
'
fit <- sem(model, std.lv=TRUE, data=newdata)
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

But I run into the following error/warning when using the R code above. Is there something else I need to specify?

Error in solve.default(E) :
Lapack routine dgesv: system is exactly singular: U[5,5] = 0
Warning message:
In estimateVCOV(lavaanModel, samplestats = lavaanSampleStats, options = lavaanOptions,  :
lavaan WARNING: could not compute standard errors!

 Thanks,

 -Shubhabrata

This one is not in the lavaan syntax:

wll1 ~~ 1*wll1

or (perhaps better here), use std.lv=TRUE argument in the fitting function.

Yves.
